author: Carl Dea
html:
Sirisha,
Excellent blog post on the new Java records!

Just for fun and not to be nit-picky (I was in a code review mood) 🙂
With the new String facility (Java 13) the code’s overridden toString() method could look like the following:
public String toString() {
return “””
Delivery(order=%s, donuts=%d)
“””.formated(order.toString(), donuts.toBag().toStringOfItemToCount() );
}

Assuming order is not null. or use String.valueOf(order). Really wish there was a null safe operator.

Carl
